outputs.explanation: The mRNA distribution panels in A are spatial heatmap-style plots overlaid on tissue images, showing per-spot expression color intensity. Heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel B consists only of H&E and RNAscope fluorescence micrograph images; no averaged/summary plot is shown, so the check does not apply.
Panel C is a scatter/dot plot where each dot represents one patient tumor (LUAD n=512, LUSC n=500) with median and 95% CI overlaid; individual data points are directly displayed.
Panel D is a bar chart (mean ± SD) with individual data points (dots for each of the n=3 replicates) overlaid on each bar.
